POST /v1/tweets
Authorization: Bearer <token>
body: { "text": "hi" }   # user 从 token 解出

q: 深挖（Deep Dives）环节要用剩余 ~10 分钟做哪些事？（多选）

Handle edge cases and identify and fix bottlenecks.
Improve the design based on the interviewer's probing questions.

    Edge --> Improve["Improve design"]
    Improve --> Signals["Answer probes"]

options_en: How to design the user registration flow.
The tweet character-count validation rule.

tradeoff: fanout-on-write『写时推送，读取快但发帖贵』 vs fanout-on-read『读时聚合，写入便宜但大 V 读取慢』
diagram:
flowchart LR
    Feed["Low-latency feed"] --> Read["Fanout on read"]
    Feed --> Write["Fanout on write"]
    Read --> Cache["Cache hot reads"]
    Write --> Queue["Async fanout"]
